title: feat(platform-objects): an organization sets the display decimal places of each standard unit of measure (ADR-0158 U6)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg8ZBQe4UHadd2fGHGeWRW9V)_

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbdHk3orAeensH6EzS

Fixes #35498
Refs #35339

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 管理员在设置的「配置」下、「计量单位」下面多一个「标准单位设置」页，可以给千克、克、件等国际标准单位各设一个显示小数位（比如珠宝行把克设成 3 位，砂石场把千克设成 0 位）；所有成员都能看到这些设置，别的组织看不到。
- 这是「计量单位」第一期里你选的「组织可改，新开一处设置」那一项；数量按单位显示的卡片会读它，本改动本身还不改变任何页面上数字的显示。
- 只有组织管理员能新增、修改或删除，删除即清除；每次改动都记审计；组织里还留着设置时不能删除该组织，要先删掉设置，和汇率一样；可以直接撤回，因为还没有地方读取它。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/platform-objects`**: new organization-owned object `sys_standard_unit_setting` (ADR-0158 U6; Open item 10 option A), registered in the first manifest beside `sys_unit`.
  - `code`: text, max 3. A format rule admits exactly the `STANDARD_UNITS` codes in exact uppercase (`STANDARD_UNIT_SETTING_CODE_PATTERN`). Unique per organization, immutable after create.
  - `decimal_places`: 0 to 12, scale 0, required.
  - Field history on both columns. No tenancy opt-out, so `organization_id` is injected.
  - Setup → Configuration → Standard Unit Settings, directly under Units of Measure, with all eleven nav labels translated. The translation bundles are regenerated; the zh-CN object strings are translated.
- **`@objectstack/plugin-security`**:
  - `member_default` reads it (read only).
  - `organization_admin` gets an explicit line: create, edit and delete. Clearing a setting is deleting its row.
- **`@objectstack/spec`**: `sys_standard_unit_setting` joins `PLATFORM_OBJECTS_BY_PACKAGE['platform-objects']`.
- **`@objectstack/cli`**:
  - The organization-ownership inventory lists the object as attributed.
  - The Setup nav count pin goes from 36 to 37.
- `scripts/platform-object-tenancy-census.json` is regenerated.

**Precedent: `sys_unit.decimal_places`.** The setting follows the same concept as an org unit's own decimal places: range 0 to 12, field history, member read, organization-admin write. The settings-key route (ADR-0144 D4's `localization.currency`) was measured and not followed, for four reasons. It is one org-wide scalar. Members read it only through a server projection. Its audit keeps hashes, not values. A per-code map would need a new settings column kind. The area approved this on claim amendments 7178077326 and 7178144166.

**Deviations from the first shape, all on the card (amendments 7178077326, 7178144166, 7179529249):**
- **No reader in this PR (amendment 7178077326).** The display card #35490 adds the reader with its first caller, and the ADR-0158 L4 clamp to the field's `scale` goes there. "A member can read them" is met by `member_default` read over the data API.
- **Clear = delete, not set-to-null (amendment 7178144166).** An organization delete refuses `DELETE_RESTRICTED` while any organization-owned row remains. Only `sys_unit` is exempt, through the engine's own cascade. So a row with no delete would block the organization delete forever. This follows `sys_exchange_rate`'s posture: an admin deletes the setting, then the organization delete goes through. Pinned below.

**Why `code` is text plus a format rule, not a select.** A select's option values are stored lowercase (`kgm`), while a unit code is stored in exact uppercase everywhere (U4). The rule's pattern is built from the `STANDARD_UNITS` keys, so a code the table gains is admitted with no second edit.

First files to read, by risk:
1. `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/default-permission-sets.ts`: the two `sys_standard_unit_setting` lines.
2. `packages/platform-objects/src/system/sys-standard-unit-setting.object.ts`: the format rule and the immutable-code rule.
3. `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/default-permission-sets.standard-unit-setting.integration.test.ts`: the tenancy posture it boots under.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/default-permission-sets.standard-unit-setting.integration.test.ts` prints 15 passed. It boots a real stack under the `isolated` tenancy posture. It shows each of these:
- an admin and an owner set, change and clear a setting, each act landing in `sys_audit_log` with old and new values;
- an admin changes and deletes a setting the owner created, and the owner one the admin created (the `organization_admin` line, no superuser bits);
- a member reads, and is refused 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` on every write;
- another organization's setting is never read, changed or cleared;
- a non-standard or lowercase code, an out-of-range value, a duplicate code and a changed code are each refused;
- an organization delete refuses 409 `DELETE_RESTRICTED` naming this object, and succeeds once the setting is deleted.

## Tests

**Rework round 1 (L1 7180149059, contract record 7180135740), head `98cbc47602`.** S1: the changeset sentence and the object's docblock now state the posture the isolation holds under (`isolated`; `single` raises no wall, `group` walls by membership, ADR-0105 D1), and N1 says the display card #35490 *will* read the value. S2: new cases where an admin and an owner each change and delete a setting the other created, plus the effective-permission map (delete kept, no `modifyAllRecords`). Affected tests re-run: the real-stack suite 15 passed (15), the declaration suite 14 passed (14). Ablation of the `organization_admin` line to `allowEdit: false, allowDelete: false` turned 8 of 15 red, the new cross-creator cases among them; restored, with the blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty.

All readings below are on head `03e453e3`, and the tree is byte-identical to the commit.

<details><summary>Package suites and typecheck (under the verify lock)</summary>

- `@objectstack/plugin-security`, `src/default-permission-sets.standard-unit-setting.integration.test.ts`: Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 12 passed (12).
- `@objectstack/platform-objects`, full suite: Test Files 127 passed (127), Tests 2176 passed (2176). This includes the new `sys-standard-unit-setting.object.test.ts`.
- `@objectstack/cli` unit layer, `src/utils/organization-ownership-inventory.test.ts` and `test/connect-agent-both-halves-wire.pin.test.ts`: Test Files 2 passed (2), Tests 28 passed (28). The CLI integration layer is left to CI.
- `@objectstack/spec`, `src/system/constants/platform-object-names.test.ts`: Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 14 passed (14).
- Typecheck of `platform-objects`, `plugin-security`, `cli` and `spec`: run in one `set -e` batch that reached its last part, so each exited 0. `platform-objects` reports `check:test-typecheck: OK`.
- The full `plugin-security` suite and `test:repo` are left to CI.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: the member read grant</summary>

- `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` changed `member_default`'s `sys_standard_unit_setting` line to `allowRead: false`. Evidence: anchor x1 → x0, blob `d4a112e3` → `87691407`.
- The suite went 2 failed | 10 passed. The member read test and the cross-organization read test both failed with `PermissionDeniedError`.
- Restored: the blob equals HEAD (`d4a112e3`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The cross-organization pins need the `isolated` posture.** Under the default `single` posture no tenant wall stands, so another organization's row is visible. That is ADR-0105 D1's design, and every organization-owned object behaves the same way. The suite registers `tenancy: { posture: 'isolated' }`, as a deployment with organizations runs. The first run without it showed the other organization's row, which is how this was found. The `sys_unit` suite pins no cross-organization read.
- **External members get no read**, the same as `sys_unit`. The display card #35490 already owes what an external member sees (comment 7030066814).
- **No ADR text in this diff.** The ADR-0158 amendment (U3, U6 and L4 notes, and the Open item 10 answer) is drafted in the card report; the area lands it as row 7179515770 on the weekly ADR revisions card #37245 after this PR merges.
- **Locale fill.** zh-CN carries translated object strings. The other nine locales carry the generator's English fill; nav labels are translated in all eleven.

## Verification

<details><summary>Derived gate families (106 families, 212 commands) and the --ran reconciliation</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 212 commands from the tree at `03e453e3`. Each was run, with its exit code captured before any pipe.
- 211 exited 0. Five of those first exited 3 because a build prerequisite was missing: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed an unshallowed clone, and `check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n-coverage` and `check:published-readme-exports` needed a full build. All five exited 0 after `git fetch --unshallow` and a full turbo build (122 of 122 tasks).
- `pnpm check:platform-checklist` exited 1 on one problem: `areas/automation.json` cites `FlowItemMoreMenu.tsx#FlowItemMoreMenu`, a symbol the `ui/` file no longer declares. That is the base tree's own state: this diff touches neither `ui/` nor `docs/qa/`, and the cited file is the same on `origin/main`.
- `--ran` printed: "106 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 106 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 106 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".

</details>

<details><summary>Overlap check</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --branch=HEAD` against origin/main `02520ab480` printed "VERDICT clean exit 0". Two open PRs share a file, #37371 (`default-permission-sets.ts`) and #37366 (`platform-objects/src/plugin.ts`); both merge cleanly with this branch.

</details>

<details><summary>Not measured locally</summary>

- The CLI `integration` layer, `test:repo`, the full `plugin-security` suite and the repo-wide lint are left to CI.
- Dogfood: n/a. The title has no `!`, and Clause-② is a widening.

</details>
